security.title: Security
security.subtitle: The second factor of your own account and the list of devices it was opened from. You come here when access may have reached the wrong hands — to close the extra sessions.
security.secretHint: Move the key into an authenticator app and enter the code. Shown once.

disableConfirm.title: Turn off two-factor authentication?
disableConfirm.body: Without it, a password alone opens the console — and every hotel on the platform. Enter the code from your app to confirm it is you.

login.title: NaviRoom Control
login.codeHint: Six digits from your authenticator app

overview.title: Platform overview
overview.subtitle: The whole platform at a glance: how many hotels, how many orders were in progress when the page opened, whether everything responds. This is the first stop — to be sure nothing stalled overnight.

health.scheduler_down: Scheduled-job service has not responded for {{count}} min — scheduled work is not running
health.bot_no_token: Telegram bot not connected: no token set
health.bot_conflict: Bot @{{name}}: another server is polling it (409)
health.bot_down: The bot service has not responded for {{count}} min

bulkDisableConfirm.title: Disable {{count}} hotels?
bulkDisableConfirm.body: These hotels' storefronts and panels will stop opening and orders will not be accepted. Turn them back on with “Enable”.

field.name: Name
field.languagesHint: Codes separated by commas. The first one is the default.
field.subdomainWhy: The subdomain is the hotel key and is printed on room QR codes: changing it would turn them into junk.
field.cityHint: Rule-based groups slice the fleet by it

hotel.activeOff: Disabled — storefront and CMS are closed
hotel.adminHint: Creates or resets access. The password is emailed to the hotel admin — the operator never sees it.
hotel.readOnly: Editing the profile is available to the owner and support roles.
hotel.adminMoveHint: For when the old mailbox is lost: the address changes without sending anything, and the password reset then goes to the new one.

intro.modules: What the hotel has switched on. A module that needs a connection does not work without it — the card will tell you.
intro.data: An export of everything the hotel has accumulated, and its shutdown with data erasure. You come here when a hotel leaves the platform or demands its data by law.
intro.overview: What keeps the hotel from working right now and what to do about it. Checks update every minute.
intro.connections: The connector on the hotel server and other external systems: online or not, version, key.
intro.rooms: Buildings and floors at a glance: where rooms are, whether control is ready and what to fix. Rooms with the same position are stacked.
intro.roomControl: Room variants: plan, zones, guest buttons and equipment — step by step from basics to publishing.
intro.journal: Support entries into the hotel panel and the room equipment log.
intro.history: Every change made to the hotel in Control: profile, modules, connections, group, disabling, administrators, room control, support entries — who, when, what it was and what it became.

admins.title: Hotel administrators
admins.hint: Who signs in to this hotel’s CMS. An extra administrator is usually a typo in the address.
admins.lastHint: The last one cannot be revoked: the hotel would lose access to its CMS.
admins.existing: The hotel already has an administrator: {{list}}. Check the address — a second full admin is usually a typo.

currencyConfirm.title: Switch currency to {{code}}?
currencyConfirm.body: {{code}} has {{next}} decimal places, the hotel now uses {{current}}. Prices are stored in minor units, so changing the decimals shifts every price: {{before}} becomes {{after}}. Change the decimals only if prices are already entered in the new currency; otherwise keep them and review prices.

activeConfirm.offBody: The storefront and panel stop opening, all staff are signed out, and orders are not accepted.
activeConfirm.onBody: The storefront opens to guests, staff can sign in again, and orders are accepted.

modules.connectionHelp: The module works only together with this connection. It can be switched on without it — then the module will not work and the hotel overview will show a problem.

create.title: New hotel
create.name: Name
create.languagesHint: the first one is the hotel default
create.doneHint: The hotel sets itself up from here in its CMS.
create.donePasswordSent: Password sent to the administrator at {{email}}
create.subdomain_format: {{min}} to {{max}} characters: Latin letters, digits, a hyphen not at the ends
create.subdomain_reserved: This name is reserved by the platform
create.hotel_exists: A hotel with this subdomain already exists

modules.title: Modules
modules.subtitle: A module is a part of the product switched on for a hotel separately: room control, marketing and others. Open a module to see what it gives and which hotels have it on.
modules.search: Module name or what it gives
modules.emptyText: No module matches the search and filters. Press “Reset”.
modules.needsNote: Without the “{{what}}” connection the module does not work at a hotel — the hotel overview will show it as a problem.
modules.defaultsHelp: A hotel gets this value when the module is switched on for it the first time. For a single hotel it can be changed in the hotel card.
modules.defaultsEmptyText: This module has no settings a new switch-on receives.
modules.hotelsHelp: The switch turns the module on or off for one hotel. To switch it on for many at once, open a group in “Hotels” and choose “Actions”.
modules.noHotelsText: Remove the filter or change the search.
modules.journalHelp: Who switched this module on or off at hotels, and when. The full story is in the hotel’s “History” tab.
modules.journalEmptyText: When the module is switched on or off at a hotel, an entry appears here.
modules.devNote: The module is still in development: it cannot be switched on. Once it works, it will get a switch.
modules.wasOn: on, but does nothing — switch it off
modules.toggleHelp: Turns the module on or off for this hotel. Other modules stay as they are; the change goes to the hotel history.
modules.devHelp: This module is not ready yet — it cannot be switched on. If it was on before, it can be switched off.

nodes.title: On-premise
nodes.subtitle: Servers standing inside the hotels themselves. Needed where room control or the hotel management system (PMS) is on: the cloud cannot reach equipment inside the building.
nodes.empty: No servers yet. They appear at hotels with room control or a hotel management system (PMS).
nodes.reissueWarning: Reissue the key for node “{{name}}”? The old key stops working immediately. The connector does not reload the key by itself — restart it with the new key.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke the key of node “{{name}}”?
revokeConfirm.body: The connector of “{{hotel}}” disconnects immediately: guests lose room control until you issue a new key and restart the connector with it.

reissueConfirm.title: Issue a new key for node “{{name}}”?

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Who can reach /admin
team.empty: You are the only platform user so far.

roleConfirm.title: Change the role of {{email}}?
roleConfirm.body: “{{from}}” → “{{to}}”. Permissions change immediately across every hotel this person can see.

twoFactorReset.title: Reset two-factor authentication for {{email}}?
twoFactorReset.body: The secret is erased and all of this member's sessions end. They can sign in with the password and turn two-factor back on in “Security”. The action is logged.

team.emailHelp: A sign-in email for Control goes to this address. The email is also the member’s login.
team.roleHelp: Owner — everything, including the team and dangerous actions. Support — hotels and entering a hotel panel. Read only — look, change nothing.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.subtitle: Every platform action — who, what, when

hotel.control_server_removed: Control server address — from the connector file

notification.telegram_group_removed: Bot removed from the Telegram group

bot.take: Order taken with a Telegram button
bot.triage: Review taken with a Telegram button

enter.title: Enter “{{hotel}}”
enter.hint: Opens the hotel CMS on behalf of the platform. A reason is required, the session expires, everything is audited.
enter.audited: Every action in this session is marked as a support edit.

templates.title: Dictionaries
templates.subtitle: The blanks a new hotel is assembled from: a set of venues and the lists of allergens and markers shared by everyone. You come here before creating a hotel — to check what it will open with.
templates.noServices: No services — the hotel adds its own
templates.note: A template only sets the START. It is not tied to the hotel: editing it later changes nothing for hotels already created.
templates.dictNote: A hotel gets its own copy on creation and may deactivate entries. Edits here reach new hotels.
templates.dictEmpty: The dictionary is empty so far.
templates.dictIntro: The reference lists of allergens and markers, shared across the platform. Every new hotel receives a COPY and edits it on its own side: a change here reaches only hotels created after it.

divergence.title: Divergence from the source
divergence.clean: Every hotel follows the source: no local edits.
divergence.hint: A hotel's edit is never overwritten automatically. Copies return to the source only from here — one hotel or the selected ones.

resetConfirm.title: Reset {{count}} hotels to the reference?
resetConfirm.body: The hotel's edits to system entries are erased: changed entries go back to the reference, entries the hotel turned off become visible to guests again, deleted ones reappear. The hotel's own entries stay. This cannot be undone.

templates.activeHelp: An inactive template is not offered when a new hotel is created. Hotels already created from it stay as they are.
templates.dictKindHelp: Dictionary section: allergens or dietary markers.
templates.dictCodeHelp: A short Latin name without spaces: hotels recognise the entry by it on updates. Guests and staff never see it.
templates.dictTitleHelp: How guests and staff will see the entry. A hotel adds translations to other languages itself.

data.exportHint: Hand the hotel its data. Reversible, can be done any number of times.
data.offboardHint: Stopping processing. Two steps: marking disables the hotel, erasure is irreversible.
data.marked: Hotel marked for shutdown and switched off.
data.deleteTitle: Remove the hotel from the registry
data.deleteHint: Data is erased by the shutdown; this is about the hotel itself: it leaves the lists, the address is freed and becomes available again. The row stays soft-deleted: the platform must still be able to answer that the hotel existed.
data.deleted: Hotel “{{subdomain}}” removed, the name is free
data.reasonHelp: Why the hotel is leaving the platform. The reason goes to the log and is visible only to the Control team — the hotel does not see it.

support.title: Support sessions
support.subtitle: Active platform staff sessions inside hotels. A revoked session dies on the very next request.
support.empty: No one is inside any hotel right now.
support.emptyHint: They appear when a team member enters the hotel panel with “Enter the hotel” — with a reason and a time limit.

errors.http: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have rights for this action.

groups.title: Hotel groups
groups.subtitle: Slices of the fleet for bulk actions: network, city, test, campaign
groups.empty: No groups yet. The first one gives bulk actions an address.
groups.name: Name
groups.ruleComposition: Composition computed by the rule right now

modeHint.list: You add hotels; the composition is stored
modeHint.rule: The composition is computed every time — new hotels join on their own

deleteConfirm.title: Delete group “{{name}}”?
deleteConfirm.body: Hotels in the group: {{count}}. The hotels stay; the group disappears from filters and bulk actions, and the only way back is to create it again.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.subtitle: All hotels on the platform. A group brings together hotels of one owner: they share an administrator, dictionaries and a summary. Open a hotel to see what is in its way, or select several and act on all of them at once.

help.link: Connection of the connector — the program on the hotel server through which guests control light and climate. “Offline” — the connector has been silent for more than 3 minutes.
help.state: “Ready” — the hotel checks have passed. The number of problems is how many checks failed. The checks will appear in the hotel overview in the next batch.

ungrouped.title: Hotels without a group
ungrouped.hint: Separate hotels. Select them and press “To group…” or drag them onto a group above.

group.name: Name
group.descriptionPlaceholder: Whose hotels these are and why they are together
group.noteHint: Visible only to us: agreements, contacts, specifics.
group.colorHint: Colour label — helps to spot the group in the hotel list
group.emptyHint: No hotels in the group yet. Select hotels and press “To group…” or drag them here.

create.title: New group
create.subtitle: A group brings together hotels of one owner. Only our team sees it — guests and hotel staff never do.
create.hotelsHint: Hotels of the group — choose now or add later

edit.title: Edit group
edit.subtitle: Name, description, note and colour are visible only to our team.

delete.title: Delete group “{{title}}”?
delete.subtitle: Only the group is deleted. Hotels stay as they are — with modules, rooms and data — and move to “Hotels without a group”.
delete.confirmHint: The button turns on when the name matches.

move.subtitle: A hotel belongs to at most one group: it leaves the previous one by itself.

picker.search: Find a hotel: name, subdomain, city
picker.none: No such hotels. Check the spelling.
picker.picked_one: {{count}} selected. A hotel belongs to at most one group — it leaves the previous one by itself.
picker.picked_other: {{count}} selected. A hotel belongs to at most one group — it leaves the previous one by itself.

bulk.disableBody: Guests will see the hotel is unavailable, staff will be signed out. Data and settings are kept.

empty.title: Nothing found
empty.body: No hotel and no group match the search and filters. Check the spelling or remove some filters.
empty.noneBody: Create the first hotel with the “New hotel” button — it will appear here.

groupPage.noDescription: No description — add one in the group profile.

about.summary: How the group’s hotels are doing as a whole: connection and which modules are on.
about.hotels: Group members. Adding a hotel moves it here from another group or from “no group”.
about.profile: How the group is named and looks in the hotel list. Only our team sees it.
about.actions: One action in all hotels of the group at once. Before running, the dialog shows what changes for each hotel.
about.defaults: What gets turned on for a hotel automatically when it is added to the group.
about.history: Who changed what in the group and when — with before and after.

summary.roomsHint: across all hotels of the group
summary.modulesHelp: How many hotels of the group use the module. Turn it on or off for all at once in “Actions”.
summary.devOn: On, but still in development and doing nothing: {{modules}}.
summary.emptyTitle: No hotels in the group yet
summary.emptyBody: The summary appears once the group has at least one hotel.

hotels.search: Find a hotel in the group
hotels.removeHint: “Remove from group” does not touch the hotel: it moves to “Hotels without a group” with all modules and data.
hotels.emptyBody: Press “Add hotels” — take hotels without a group or move them from another group.
hotels.noMatch: Remove some filters or change the search.

profile.title: Group
profile.nameHelp: How the group is named in the hotel list and in the “Group” filter.
profile.descriptionHelp: Whose hotels these are and why they are together. Shown in the group header and in the hotel list.
profile.colorHelp: A coloured mark next to the group name — to spot it in the hotel list.
profile.orderHelp: The order of groups on the “Hotels” screen. “Hotels without a group” are always at the bottom.
profile.parentHelp: For example, “Moscow” inside “Metropol hotels”. For now groups are one level deep.
profile.parentNote: Nested groups are built into the data; the choice will appear when needed.
profile.autosave: Changes are saved as soon as you leave the field.

actions.moduleText_one: Turn a module on or off for {{count}} hotel at once. The dialog shows what changes for whom.
actions.moduleText_other: Turn a module on or off for {{count}} hotels at once. The dialog shows what changes for whom.
actions.disableText_one: Close {{count}} running hotel to guests and staff. A reason is required; data is kept.
actions.disableText_other: Close {{count}} running hotels to guests and staff. A reason is required; data is kept.
actions.enableText_one: Reopen {{count}} disabled hotel of the group to guests and staff.
actions.enableText_other: Reopen {{count}} disabled hotels of the group to guests and staff.
actions.journal: Every action is recorded in the group history and in the log of each affected hotel.

subtitle.module: The module is turned on or off for each hotel of the group. Hotels already in that state do not change.
subtitle.disable: Hotels close to guests, staff sessions end. Data is kept; you can enable them any time.
subtitle.enable: Hotels reopen to guests and staff.

action.devHidden: Modules in development are not shown — they cannot be turned on yet.
action.reasonHint: Visible only in Control — in the group history and each hotel log.

add.title: Add hotels to “{{title}}”
add.ruleOn: The group has a rule: added hotels get {{modules}} turned on.
add.ruleOff: Hotels without a group and from other groups. The “defaults for new hotels” rule is off for this group.
add.movers_one: {{count}} hotel will move from another group. Modules turned on there are not turned off.
add.movers_other: {{count}} hotels will move from other groups. Modules turned on there are not turned off.

defaults.title: Modules for new hotels of the group
defaults.on: Rule on: a hotel added to the group gets {{modules}} turned on.
defaults.onEmpty: Rule on, but no modules chosen — nothing will be turned on.
defaults.off: Rule off: an added hotel keeps the modules it had.
defaults.note1: The rule fires only when a hotel is added. Hotels already in the group do not change — use “Actions” for them.
defaults.note2: A module that needs a connection is turned on but works once the connection appears.
defaults.note3: Modules in development cannot be chosen.
defaults.switchHelp: When the rule is on, hotels added to the group get the selected modules right away. Hotels already in the group do not change.

history.emptyBody: When the group is renamed, its members change or an action runs, a record appears here: who, when and what it was before.
history.noMatchBody: Remove some filters or change the search.

metric.menuServices: with a menu and a serving place — {{count}}; items — {{items}}

card.problemsTitle: What keeps the hotel from working
card.problemsHelp: The server runs the checks — the same number appears in the “Hotels” list and in the group summary. Red: a guest already cannot do something; yellow: needs attention; blue: worth checking. The button on the right leads to where it is fixed.
card.disabledNote: The hotel is disabled. The checks below are for when it is enabled again; the hotel list does not count them.
card.noProblemsBody: The hotel is ready for guests. If something breaks, a check appears here within a minute.
card.roomRulesSkipped_one: Room control is off — {{count}} room check is not needed.
card.roomRulesSkipped_other: Room control is off — {{count}} room checks are not needed.

module_without_connection.title: “{{module}}” is on without a connection
module_without_connection.detail: It needs a connector on the hotel server. Until there is one, the guest sees the module but it does not work.

connector_silent.title: Connector “{{node}}” is offline
connector_silent.detail: Last {{ago}}. Guest commands do not reach the rooms.
connector_silent.never: It has never connected — the key is not installed on site.

rooms_without_variant.detail: Guests in these rooms will see “this room is not controlled”.
rooms_without_variant.passed: Every room has a control variant

variant_unpublished.title: Variant “{{variant}}” is not published
variant_unpublished.detail_one: {{count}} room is waiting for the first version.
variant_unpublished.detail_other: {{count}} rooms are waiting for the first version.

no_menu_service.title: No service with a menu and a serving place
no_menu_service.detail: Guests have nothing to order: no venue accepts orders to a place where the guest can receive them.
no_menu_service.passed: There is a service with a menu and a serving place

rooms_without_pin.detail: A guest cannot confirm the room or switch on the light until a PIN is issued.

admin_never_logged_in.title_one: The administrator has never signed in
admin_never_logged_in.title_other: None of the {{count}} administrators has ever signed in
admin_never_logged_in.detail: {{emails}} — the password may not have arrived or got lost.

control_server_silent.title: The control server does not respond
control_server_silent.detail: The connector is online, but the control server behind it does not respond — guests cannot control rooms.

card.noModules: No modules — guests see only the menu and orders.

activation.title: Disabling the hotel
activation.onText: Closes the hotel to guests and staff; data and settings are kept, and it can be enabled again at any time.
activation.offText: The hotel is disabled: guests and staff cannot get in. Data and settings are kept.
activation.onlyHere: Only the platform team sees the reason.

connections.about: A program on the hotel server that carries guest commands to the room equipment.
connections.aboutHelp: The link goes from the inside out: the connector checks in with us itself. “Offline” means it has not checked in for more than 3 minutes.
connections.keyOnce: The key of connector “{{name}}” is shown once — save it now. Later it can only be reissued.
connections.emptyBody: Needed when room control is on: without it guest commands do not reach the equipment.
connections.otherSoon: will appear here once they are connected

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.moduleOff: room control is off — variants and PINs are not used
rooms.emptyBody: The hotel adds rooms in its panel or uploads a list. Once they exist, you will see the layout here: buildings, floors and rooms stacked above each other.
rooms.noMatchBody: Remove some filters or change the search.

help.control: Whether a guest can control light and climate from the phone. Derived from settings: hotel link, room variant, its publication and PIN. Room equipment is not polled here.
help.variant: Which control setup the room has. Identical rooms — usually stacked above each other — share one variant.
help.pin: Whether the room has a valid PIN for guest access to room control.
help.problems: The most important thing blocking the room. All reasons are in the room card.
help.occupancy: Occupied, vacant, cleaning. Will appear once the hotel booking system is connected.

legend.hint: Hover a legend row to highlight those rooms on the layout.

fix.title: What to fix
fix.help: What stops guests from controlling the room, most important first. “Show” keeps only those rooms on screen.
fix.allGood: Nothing blocks guests: every room has a published variant, a PIN, and the hotel is online.
fix.moduleOff: Room control is not connected for this hotel. The layout shows rooms, buildings and floors only.

rule.title: How to read a room number
rule.help: Rooms with the same position are stacked above each other and share a column on the layout. A floor set on the room and a manual position override the rule.
rule.dialogTitle: How to read a room number
rule.exampleNoFloor: For example, “{{number}}”: no floor in the number, position {{position}}.
rule.allByRule: Floors and positions of all rooms follow the rule.
rule.floorsAllRule: Floors of all rooms follow the rule.
rule.floorsAllRoom: Floors are set on the rooms.
rule.floorsSomeRule_one: {{count}} room takes its floor from the rule.
rule.floorsSomeRule_other: {{count}} rooms take their floor from the rule.

place.title: Position on the floor
place.help: The position is the room's place on its floor; rooms with the same position are stacked. It is normally read from the number — set it manually if the room is not where the rule puts it.

add.firstExample: For example: “101-120, 201-220” — forty rooms on two floors at once.
add.title: Add rooms
add.subtitle: One room, a list or a range. Rooms that already exist are not duplicated.
add.specHelp: Comma-separated: “201-212” is a range, “3A” and “Suite-1” are taken as written. Leading zeros are kept: “008-012”.
add.limit: No more than 500 rooms at a time.
add.floorHelp: Empty — the floor is read from the number by the rule.
add.previewEmpty: Type room numbers — what will be added appears here.
add.restoreHelp: The room comes back with its past orders and chat; the previous guest's PIN and sessions are removed.
add.freshHelp: A new room without history; the deleted one stays archived under another name.

edit.numberHelp: Changing the number changes the QR link — consequences are shown before saving.
edit.floorHelp: A floor set here overrides the “how to read a room number” rule. Empty — the floor is read from the number.
edit.floorNone: The number has no floor — set it manually.
edit.positionSet: Position set manually — it overrides the rule.
edit.noVariants: The hotel has no variants yet — they are created on the “Room control” tab.
edit.deviceHelp: How the room is named on the control server. Usually from the variant template; set it manually if this room is named differently.
edit.is_activeHelp: Whether the room lets a guest in by QR. A disabled room does not open for guests and is not printed on the QR sheet.
edit.is_activeOn: The room lets guests in by QR.
edit.is_activeOff: QR entry is off — guests cannot open the room.
edit.out_of_serviceHelp: The room is under repair or closed. It does not affect guests — it is a note for the hotel.
edit.out_of_serviceOn: The room is marked out of order.
edit.noProblems: Nothing blocks: guests can control the room.

why.no_link: No link to the hotel server — guest commands go nowhere. Check the connection.
why.no_variant: The room has no control variant — guests have nothing to control.
why.not_published: The room variant is not published yet — guests do not see it.
why.no_pin: The room has no PIN and entry without PIN is off — guests cannot enter control.
why.demo_entry: No PIN, guests use demo entry without a code — only for demonstrations.

edit.leaveBody: If you leave, changes to this room will be lost.
edit.renameQr: The QR link will change — the sticker in the room must be reprinted.
edit.renameSessions: Live guest sessions in the room: {{count}} — they will keep working.

access.expired: The PIN has expired — guests cannot enter.
access.demo: No PIN — guests use demo entry without a code.
access.none: No PIN — guests cannot control the room.
access.help: The PIN is the stay code: guests type it to control the room. Only a fingerprint of the code is stored; the code itself cannot be viewed.
access.once: The code is shown once — write it down or tell the guest. It cannot be viewed again.
access.clearBody: A guest who entered with this PIN loses control of the room.

del.title: Delete room {{number}}?
del.lead: The room disappears from the inventory. Also:
del.variant: The room is unlinked from variant “{{variant}}”.
del.history: Orders and chat stay in history; the room can be restored by adding it again.

building.title: Buildings
building.subtitle: A name in each hotel language. A building with rooms can only be deleted by moving its rooms.
building.busy: Rooms in the building: {{count}}. Where to move them?
building.free: The building has no rooms — it is deleted right away.

category.title: Categories
category.subtitle: A name in each hotel language. A category with rooms can only be deleted by moving its rooms.
category.busy: Rooms in the category: {{count}}. Where to move them?
category.free: The category has no rooms — it is deleted right away.

sel.readOnly: Actions on rooms require edit rights.
sel.shownHelp: Select every room on screen — with the current search and filters.
sel.modeHint: Selection mode: a tap selects a room. “Clear selection” exits the mode.

batch.subtitle: First we show what changes for each room. Exactly what is shown runs, in one step.

help.variant: A variant is the room control setup. If it changes, the guest sees a different control screen.
help.pin: Issue: each room gets its own random PIN, shown once. Remove: the guest loses control. Validity: changes the date of the active PIN, the code stays.
help.category: The room category from the hotel's list.
help.building: The room's building. “Remove building” leaves the room without a building.
help.state: “Out of order” is a note for the hotel. “Guest entry” — whether the room lets a guest in by QR.
help.delete: Deletion is soft: a room can be restored by adding it again.

batch.issueHelp: Validity for all issued PINs; empty — no end.
batch.deleteLead: Rooms are deleted softly: the PIN is removed, guest sessions are closed, the variant link is removed.

warn.variant_changes_one: {{count}} room changes variant — the guest sees a different control screen.
warn.variant_changes_other: {{count}} rooms change variant — guests see a different control screen.
warn.pin_replaces: PIN already exists — rooms: {{count}}. It will be replaced; the old one stops working.

pins.once: The PINs are shown once. Download or print them now — after closing they cannot be viewed, only issued again.
pins.closeWarning: These PINs will not be shown again. Press “Done” once more to close.

journal.supportHelp: When platform staff entered this hotel’s panel and why. An active entry can be cut off.
journal.hardwareHelp: Commands and reads of room equipment: when, room, element, how it ended.

disable.title: Disable “{{name}}”?
disable.subtitle: Data, settings and rooms are kept. It can be enabled again at any time.
disable.reasonHint: Visible only here, in Control. The hotel, guests and staff never see the reason.
disable.enableOnHint: Optional. Empty — the hotel stays disabled until enabled by hand.

what.guest: instead of the storefront — a screen in the hotel brand “The hotel is not taking orders right now”; orders and chat are closed
what.staff: open sessions end; the sign-in form is shown but signing in fails — “Sign-in unavailable”, no reason given
what.room: no commands go to the equipment; the connector stays connected
what.control: the hotel is marked “disabled” in the list with the reason, who and when

roomControl.typeHelp: The room variant set up below: upload, builder, plan, versions. Rooms are bound to a variant on the “Room inventory” tab.
roomControl.moduleOff: Room control is off for this hotel. Switch the module on in the “Modules” tab — then room variants, the commissioning file upload, the plan and the equipment log appear here.

conn.title: Room control connection
conn.overviewTitle: Room control is on but not connected
conn.overviewBody: The wizard walks you through: the connector on the hotel server, the control server, a room check.

connector.noneSub: a program on the hotel server — the road to the control server

server.addressFile: address — in the file on the hotel server

source.local: address set on the hotel server
source.unknown: the connector has not reported yet

rooms.sub: with a variant and a published layout

fact.inControl: Set in Control, not in effect

conn.useFile: Use the address from the file
conn.useFileHelp: “Use the address from the file” removes the address from Control: the connector goes back to the address in its file on the hotel server.

apply.none: No server set in Control — the connector uses the address from its file on the hotel server.
apply.applied: The connector accepted the server settings.
apply.offline: The connector is offline — it will accept the settings when it comes online.
apply.waiting: Waiting for the connector to reply…

error.outside_allowed: The connector refused: address {{address}} is outside the allowed circle.
error.no_allowed_circle: The connector refused: it has no allowed circle.
error.bad_address: The connector refused: this does not look like a server address.
error.unknown_endpoint: The connector refused: it does not know such a server.
error.other: The connector did not accept the settings.

todo.outside_allowed: What to do: add this address to the connector's allowed circle on the hotel server (the command from the wizard's “Connector” step) or fix the address here.
todo.no_allowed_circle: What to do: update the connector settings on the hotel server with the command from the wizard's “Connector” step — it includes the allowed circle.
todo.bad_address: What to do: check the address and port.
todo.unknown_endpoint: What to do: update the connector to version 1.1.
todo.other: What to do: open the connection wizard and go through the steps again.

check.down: The connector is online but the control server does not respond.
check.noConnector: The connector is offline — nothing to check with.
check.oldConnector: The connector did not answer the check.

todo.down: What to do: make sure the control server is on and the address and port are right.
todo.noConnector: What to do: start the connector on the hotel server or issue a new key.
todo.oldConnector: What to do: the connector may be outdated — update it to 1.1.

form.title: Control server
form.kindHelp: Which server controls the room equipment. iRidi is available now; Bittel and others will come later.
form.hostHelp: The control server IP or name — as the connector sees it. Without “http://” or a path.
form.protocolHelp: How the connector talks to the server: usually without encryption, inside the hotel network.
form.authHelp: Whether the control server needs sign-in. Passwords and tokens are stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.secretHelp: Stored encrypted. It cannot be viewed later — only replaced.
form.timeoutHelp: How long the connector waits for the server's reply to one command. From 500 to 30,000.
form.enabledHelp: A disabled server is not sent to the connector — the connector uses the address from its file.

wiz.title: Connect room control
wiz.what1: A guest taps “Light” on the phone. The command goes to the NaviRoom cloud, then to the connector on the hotel server, which passes it to the control server, which switches the light.
wiz.what2: The control server sits in the hotel network and is not visible from outside. So a connector is installed at the hotel: it calls the cloud itself and keeps the link. The server address is set here, but the connector accepts it only within the allowed circle set at installation.
wiz.connectorLead: Choose a connector or set up a new one. The install command contains the key and the allowed circle — where the connector may go by the address from Control.
wiz.circle: Allowed circle: network or server name
wiz.circleHelp: A network like 10.10.20.0/24 or a server name. The connector accepts the control server address from Control only if it is inside this circle.
wiz.alreadyOnline: This connector is already online — you can go on. A new key is needed only to change the allowed circle.
wiz.issueNew: Issue a key and show the command
wiz.issueAgain: Reissue the key and show the command
wiz.issueAgainWarn: The old key stops working right away: the connector disconnects until the new command is run on the hotel server.
wiz.keyOnce: The key is shown once — in this command.
wiz.waiting: Waiting for the connector to come online… Usually a minute after running the command.
wiz.server: Set the control server. After saving, the connector gets the settings and replies whether it accepted them.
wiz.roomLead: Choose a room and read its state — read only, no commands to the equipment.

readReason.no_type: The room has no control variant — nothing to read.
readReason.no_config: The room variant is not published.
readReason.no_feedback: The variant has no channels that can be read.
readReason.no_answer: The room equipment did not answer on any channel. Check the room device name and the control server.

wiz.readSafe: This was read only: no commands were sent to the room.
wiz.noRooms: The hotel has no rooms with a control variant — check a room later on the “Room control” tab.

profile.languagesHint: Guests see the name and city in their language; an empty translation falls back to the main language.

confirm.title: Confirm the change
confirm.subtitle: Guests and staff will notice these changes.

timezone.hours_shift: Venue hours and schedules shift: “from 08:00” becomes 08:00 in the new zone.
timezone.reports_day: “Today” reports start counting the day in the new zone.
timezone.logs_same: Log times stay the same — they are stored independently of the zone.

currency.no_recalc: Prices are stored as numbers — no conversion: 1,500 ₽ becomes 1,500 in the new currency.
currency.open_orders: Open orders and guest carts stay in the old currency.
currency.minor_separate: Decimal places are a separate setting and do not change by themselves.

currency_minor_units.prices_scale: Prices are stored in minor units: changing decimals can turn 1,500.00 into 150,000 or 15.00.
currency_minor_units.check_menu: Check the prices in the hotel menu afterwards.

subdomain.old_redirects: The old address and room QR codes will redirect to the new one until the redirect is removed by hand — no need to reprint QR codes.
subdomain.relogin: Staff and guests will sign in again at the new address.
subdomain.tls: The new address works over HTTPS after the stand certificate is reissued.

address.title: Hotel address
address.help: Guests open the storefront at this address, and room QR codes lead here. Only the owner changes it.
address.ownerOnly: Only the platform owner changes the subdomain and own domain.
address.subdomainHint: Latin letters, digits, hyphen. The old address keeps working through a redirect.
address.aliasHint: The redirect never expires. Remove it only when you are sure no old QR codes or links remain.
address.pointsHere: {{domain}} points to the platform — you can save it.
address.pointsElsewhere: {{domain}} points to {{resolved}}, not to the platform — a DNS record is needed.
address.howTitle: How to connect an own domain

how.dns: The hotel adds an A record at its registrar (or a CNAME to the hotel address on the platform).
how.check: Press “Check DNS” — the domain must point to the platform.
how.save: Save the domain: the storefront and QR codes will be built from it.
how.tls: The certificate for the domain comes with the stand certificate reissue — on the owner’s word.

group.title: Group
group.help: A group is hotels of one owner. Only our team sees it.
group.label: Hotel group
group.hint: The move goes straight into the hotel and group history.

detail.legacyCount_one: {{count}} module changed — the old entry keeps no details
detail.legacyCount_other: {{count}} modules changed — the old entry keeps no details
detail.inDevelopment: module in development — switched off on the move to modules without plans
detail.acceptedWarning: linked despite the channel meaning warning

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: No changes match the filters — remove some of them.

room_control.gives: Guests control lights, climate and curtains from their phone.
opens: Hotel panel: access, PIN, room check
Control: room variants, plan, command log

marketing.gives: Banners on the guest home screen and labels on menu items.

pms.gives: Rooms, check-ins and check-outs come from the program the hotel keeps bookings in.
opens: Hotel panel: rooms and guests arrive on their own

payment.gives: Guests pay for an order by card right in the storefront.

mobile_key.gives: The room door opens with the guest’s phone.
opens: Guest: key on the home screen

native_app.gives: The hotel storefront in app stores under the hotel’s own name.

analytics_level.gives: Reports on revenue, items and staff for any period.

multi_restaurant.gives: More than one restaurant or bar, each with its own menu and hours.

extra_languages.gives: The storefront in languages beyond Russian and English.

admin.listFilteredEmpty: Nothing found: remove some filters or press “Reset”.

variants.idea: A room variant is one setup: plan, zones, guest buttons, equipment channels. It applies at once to many identical rooms. A hotel usually has 5–10 variants.
variants.ideaShort: One setup for many identical rooms: plan, zones, guest buttons, equipment.
variants.none: No variants yet. They are created from the commissioning file.

why.connectorSilent: The connector is offline — guests cannot control rooms.
why.serverDown: The connector is online, but the control server does not respond.
why.noVariants: No variants — upload a commissioning file.

base.title: Name
base.titleHelp: What the variant is called in Control. Guests do not see it — they see their room.
base.viewHelp: How the guest sees the room: a list of buttons, a plan with zones, or a full plan where light is shown as light.

viewAbout.tiles: the guest sees buttons by zone, without a picture of the room.
viewAbout.simple: the guest sees the room plan, zones that are on are highlighted.
viewAbout.full: the guest sees the room plan, light is shown as real light.

base.originHelp: Variants are created from the commissioning file: it lists rooms and equipment channels.
base.deviceHelp: For the engineer: how the control server names the room device. The room number is {room}, for example “Room {room}”.
base.noDevice: not set — without it commands will not reach the rooms
base.importHelp: Uploading the file updates equipment channels and room assignment from the file.

plan.tiles: “Buttons” view: the plan is not shown to the guest, no frame is needed.
plan.framePair: a pair of frames: day and night
plan.frameOne: one frame — the night one is computed
plan.zonesHelp: Areas of the frame the guest taps: a tap switches the zone light.
plan.pointsHelp: Separate points: for example an air conditioner or a lamp over a zone.
plan.noFrame: No plan frame — the guest will see buttons only.
plan.markupHelp: Upload the plan frame and mark zones, windows and points.

buttons.hidden_one: {{count}} button is not shown to the guest: not linked to equipment.
buttons.hidden_other: {{count}} buttons are not shown to the guest: not linked to equipment.
buttons.engineerHelp: Which control server channels stand behind each button — as they are named in the commissioning file.
buttons.missing: link missing: {{list}} — the guest will not see the button
buttons.senseWarn: linked to a channel that seems to be for something else — check
buttons.formWarn: the channel does not fit — open the button
buttons.removeAbout: The button and its channel links will be deleted; its points leave the plan. Guests will see this after publishing.
buttons.kindHelp: The kind sets the icon, state captions and which equipment links are needed.
buttons.guestTitleHelp: Empty — the guest sees the kind name: “Light”, “Curtains”.
buttons.linksHelp: Each ability of the button has its own control server channel. Required ones must be linked, otherwise the guest will not see the button.
buttons.notLinkedRequired: not linked — without it the button is not shown to the guest
buttons.sense: The channel seems to be for: {{found}}, but the button is {{expected}}.

rooms.summary_one: This variant has {{count}} of {{total}} rooms — highlighted on the layout.
rooms.summary_other: This variant has {{count}} of {{total}} rooms — highlighted on the layout.
rooms.help: The layout is the same as on the “Rooms” tab. Rooms of other variants are dimmed.
rooms.selectHint: Tap rooms, a floor or a stack to select; then assign the variant or clear it.

check.lead: Choose a room of this variant and read its state — read only, no commands to the equipment.
check.noRooms: The variant has no rooms — nothing to check.
check.readOnly: The check is run by an operator with edit rights.

publish.diffHelp: Draft versus the current version: what guests will see after publishing.
publish.same: The draft matches the current version — nothing to publish.
publish.noButtons: No ready buttons — nothing to publish.

err.variant_has_rooms: The variant has {{rooms}} rooms — first assign them another variant or clear the variant on the “Rooms” step.
err.binding_sense_warning: This channel does not seem to be for this button.
err.publish_rooms_changed: The variant rooms changed while you were looking: there are {{rooms}} now. Open the confirmation again.
err.test_needs_confirm: The command was not sent: confirm the room, button and value.
err.device_template_no_room: The device name needs the room number — put {room} where the room number goes.
err.title_required: A name is needed in at least one language.
err.no_such_ability: This button has no such ability.
err.channel_taken: The channel is already used by “{{button}}”: one channel — one button. Unlink it there or choose another channel.
err.plan_zone_unbound: A plan zone has no button: {{zones}}. Open “Plan” → “Frame and markup” and link the zone to a light button.
err.plan_refs_broken: Points or windows on the plan refer to removed buttons. Open “Plan” → “Frame and markup” and fix them.

new.title: New room variant

mode.copy: Copy of a variant of this hotel

about.blank: An empty variant: add zones and buttons in its steps; channels appear after the commissioning file is uploaded.
about.file: The commissioning file lists rooms and equipment channels. Variants are created from it and assigned to rooms right away.
about.copy: A copy: zones, buttons, channels and plan markup. Rooms are not carried over — assign them on the “Rooms” step.
about.copy_other: A copy from another hotel: only the setup — zones, buttons, channels, markup. That hotel's rooms, versions and plan frame are not carried over.

new.noSources: Other hotels have no variants yet.
new.copyNote: Rooms, versions and the plan frame are not copied: assign rooms on the “Rooms” step, upload the frame on the “Plan” step.

delete.title: Delete variant “{{name}}”?
delete.hasRooms_one: The variant has {{count}} room. It cannot be deleted: first assign another variant or clear the variant on the “Rooms” step.
delete.hasRooms_other: The variant has {{count}} rooms. It cannot be deleted: first assign them another variant or clear the variant on the “Rooms” step.
delete.sure: The variant, its buttons, channels and versions will be deleted. It has no rooms.

zones.title: Zones
zones.help: Parts of the room: living room, bedroom, bathroom. Guest buttons are grouped by zone; on the plan a zone is the area the guest taps.
zones.removeAbout_one: {{count}} button of the zone is not deleted — it moves to “No zone”. The zone and its markup leave the plan.
zones.removeAbout_other: {{count}} buttons of the zone are not deleted — they move to “No zone”. The zone and its markup leave the plan.

channels.title: {{button}}: channel for “{{ability}}”
channels.subtitle: Suitable ones first. Channels with an unsuitable value kind cannot be chosen.
channels.senseShort: seems to be a channel for: {{found}}
channels.none: No channels — upload the commissioning file on the “Basics” step.
channels.warnTitle: This channel does not seem to be for this button
channels.warnText: The button is {{button}}, but the channel name looks like: {{found}}. If linked, the guest presses one thing and another happens in the room. Link anyway?

test.nothing: The test command appears once the variant has rooms and linked buttons.
test.title: Test command to a room
test.help: A real command to the equipment: there may be a guest in the room. It is sent only after confirming “room, what, value”.

outcome.no_feedback_channel: Sent; nothing to confirm with — the channel has no state.
outcome.feedback_dead: Sent, but the state does not respond.
outcome.unconfirmed: Sent, but the state did not change.

test.confirmTitle: Send a command to the room?
test.confirmWarn: This is a real command: if a guest is in the room, they will see it.

rollback.title: Return version {{version}}?
rollback.about_one: The variant room ({{count}}) will get version {{version}}. A new version — a copy of {{version}} — appears; history is not erased.
rollback.about_other: The variant rooms ({{count}}) will get version {{version}}. A new version — a copy of {{version}} — appears; history is not erased.
